knownLimitations: The live qualification used explicitly labeled synthetic evidence. An attestor signature proves control of the nominated wallet, not the real-world sender's identity or notice authenticity. The contract is not legal advice, a document-authentication service, or a payment/settlement system. All cases remain in append-only storage; there is no deletion or pruning interface.
name: NoticeClock
short: Assess contractual notice and cure evidence against frozen terms with independent semantic consensus and an explicit inconclusive outcome.
problem: Parties disagree over whether a notice identifies an applicable breach and states a sufficiently clear cure.
solution: NoticeClock coordinates a three-party case in which the parties freeze a notice/cure clause, submit evidence, and nominate a distinct attestor wallet. GenLayer validators independently assess whether a breach is identified, the clause applies, and the requested cure is clear. State changes remain bounded by frozen terms, challenge rights, and deterministic deadlines.
outcomes: Inside gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe, the leader and validators independently evaluate breach_identified, clause_applicable, requested_cure_clear and evidence_sufficient. A strict boolean schema is checked. Contract code derives READY, INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE; disagreement cannot silently approve.
productionQualification: Standalone deployed V4 contract source and ABI verified; complete historic lifecycle finalized with recorded inconclusive/review outcome; Portal dossier prepared, not submitted.
